name: Fragile Hands
source:
Something seemed... "off" about this, But I can't put my finger on it.

Are you who they say you are?

How far will you unravel this thread? Venture through and see what awaits you.

[From [url=https://fragilehands.itch.io/fragile-hands]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
这件事似乎有些……“不对劲”，但我说不上来。

你真的是他们口中的那个人吗？

你能顺着这条线索追查到什么地步？走进去看看前方等待着什么。

[来源：[url=https://fragilehands.itch.io/fragile-hands]Itch.io[/url]]
